messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 1.3.5

1.3.5. Risks related to combined machinery Where the machinery is intended to carry out several different operations with manual removal of the piece between each operation (combined machinery), it must be designed and constructed in such a way as to enable each element to be used separately without the other elements constituting a risk for exposed persons. For this purpose, it must be possible to start and stop separately any elements that are not protected.

response.text:
Combined machinery | is intended to carry out | several different operations with manual removal of the piece between each operation | | Where the machinery is intended to carry out several different operations with manual removal of the piece between each operation (combined machinery)
Combined machinery | must be designed and constructed | to enable each element to be used separately | where the machinery is combined machinery | it must be designed and constructed in such a way as to enable each element to be used separately
Other elements of combined machinery | must not constitute | a risk for exposed persons when an element is used separately | when an element is used separately | without the other elements constituting a risk for exposed persons
Unprotected elements of combined machinery | must be capable of | being started and stopped separately | the elements are not protected | it must be possible to start and stop separately any elements that are not protected
